cases.title: traceability
cases.arrange: Compare authoritative findings table to replacement map
cases.expected: Exactly 24 substantive rows; R-001 marked reserved, every substantive row has case/evidence linkage; no claim of 25 real defects
cases.observed: Header artefact reconciled to 24 substantive original findings; stable R IDs preserved.
cases.remaining: No product defect or product test pass is attached to the reserved header ID.
cases.nextAction: Retain the correction and validate the original report when changing mappings.

cases.title: role bypass
cases.arrange: Guest/customer try listing route and direct create/update/media calls, including forged role
cases.expected: Protected data withheld; 401/403 as appropriate; no listing/object/job created. Assigned agent/admin permitted
cases.observed: Current signed customer, revoked and foreign actor denials; server-owned staff access and guarded listing commands.
cases.remaining: Production identity, native route bypass and deployed storage permissions still require verification.
cases.nextAction: Complete the real identity/browser/native denial matrix on the release candidate.

cases.title: owner/tenant denial
cases.arrange: A2 edits A1 listing; A1 sends B ID, tenant/actor/assignment values; inspect audit
cases.expected: Requests denied, unchanged records/media. Server derives actor; only authorized admin reassignment succeeds; all queries/exports/subscriptions scoped
cases.observed: Current company/assignment checks, exact operation recovery and raw viewing-table denial.
cases.remaining: Exports, subscriptions and full production pooled/storage isolation are not accepted.
cases.nextAction: Implement and test scoped export/session/job paths, then rerun the complete two-company matrix.

cases.title: logout/revoke
cases.arrange: Open private view in two tabs/mobile, sign out in one; retry cached edit and revoke membership
cases.expected: Private cards/reasons/drafts/subscriptions clear across tabs; requests denied after sign-out/revocation; no background repopulation

originalFinding.title: Logout leaves private owner view in another tab

cases.observed: A current foreign enquiry read hides loaded private details; current membership revocation is denied at SQL/API.
cases.remaining: Sign-out broadcast, two-tab private cache clearing, native expiry and subscription teardown are unimplemented or unverified.
cases.nextAction: Implement provider-backed logout/expiry and verify two tabs plus native storage.

cases.title: interruption/idempotency
cases.arrange: Interrupt file 3/4, stall past timeout, retry same session/key, cancel and resume
cases.expected: Per-file error/retry, draft retained, accepted files reused, one listing result, no public partial revision; expired objects cleaned and audited
cases.observed: Actual browser Cancel at third upload preserved two photos and recovered the original confirmed stop. Live original-instance retirement/drain, exact authorized incomplete workspace cleanup, verified/reference protection and uncertainty guards passed locally.
cases.remaining: Production provider retention/schedule/alerts, hosted process isolation and actual Android/iOS/operator interruption journeys remain open.
cases.nextAction: Verify staged provider lifecycle and actual devices; historical journals never grant new cleanup authority.

cases.title: authentication UI
cases.arrange: Enter dummy password, activate reveal and hide by keyboard/screen reader
cases.expected: Masked initially; named toggle/state; no secret logs or evidence capture
cases.observed: No replacement production password UI has been accepted.
cases.remaining: Provider login/reset/reveal UI and keyboard/screen-reader checks remain open.
